# Scanner relay fixtures

These synthetic wire fixtures describe the two fixed requests admitted by the
Nmap 7.991 scanner contract. They contain no client data. The tests verify their
lengths and SHA-256 hashes.

- `nmap-7.991-nbstat-wildcard.bin` is the fixed NBSTAT wildcard query.
- `nmap-7.991-smb2-negotiate.bin` is the fixed SMB2 negotiate request.

The installed Nmap package, source paths, revisions, hashes, and license are
recorded in the scanner catalog and third-party inventory. No Nmap source code
is copied into these fixtures.
